<p>Now's a great time to pick up a new MacBook Air if you've been thinking about taking the plunge. Amazon has the <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:1;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DZDC3WW5&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=6fff181c-d5f2-4e5f-8daf-ad7b81fb0f93&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=M4-powered%2C+13-inch+MacBook+Air&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAcF8eczwOIPzG3V-P8PU9f1LjnlDx9s6229a_0yIk5pP&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FApple-2025-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop%2Fdp%2FB0DZDC3WW5%2F" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2025-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop/dp/B0DZDC3WW5/?th=1">M4-powered, 13-inch MacBook Air</a> for a record-low price of $749 right now. The 25 percent discount applies to multiple colors, too.</p> 
<p>We ranked this as our favorite Apple laptop in our list of the <a data-i13n="cpos:2;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/laptops/best-macbook-140032524.html">best MacBook computers</a>. Heck, it's even our <a data-i13n="cpos:3;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/laptops/best-laptops-120008636.html">very favorite laptop</a>. Full stop. The performance is exceptionally snappy, thanks to the M4 chip. We appreciated the upgraded battery life, which now lasts for around 18 hours per charge. That's well beyond a full day of work.</p> <span id="end-legacy-contents"></span>
<p>
 </p> 
<p>The design is lightweight, but sturdy. This has become a hallmark for modern MacBook Air computers. The screen is both gorgeous and roomy, even though it's technically just a 13-inch panel. There's support for the P3 wide color gamut and it can reach up to 500 nits of brightness.</p> 
<p>This is a near-perfect laptop, but there are a couple of nitpicks. There's no USB-C port on the right side, limiting how users can arrange accessories on a desk. Also, the screen is capped with a 60Hz refresh rate. Another potential complication is the looming specter of the M5 chip. The company has already <a data-i13n="cpos:4;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/laptops/apple-macbook-pro-m5-14-inch-review-a-huge-graphics-upgrade-for-creators-and-gamers-170009179.html">released the MacBook Pro M5</a>, so a new MacBook Air is likely coming in the nearish future. (Read: sometime in early 2026).</p> 
<p>If you need more screen space, you'll find a similar discount on the <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:5;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DZDBWM5B&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=6fff181c-d5f2-4e5f-8daf-ad7b81fb0f93&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=15-inch+MacBook+Air&amp;custData=eyJzb3VyY2VOYW1lIjoiV2ViLURlc2t0b3AtVmVyaXpvbiIsImxhbmRpbmdVcmwiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5hbWF6b24uY29tL2RwL0IwRFpEQldNNUIvcmVmPWZzX2FfbWJ0Ml91czI_&amp;signature=AQAAAT4QBkXdSgCE66ucPnyCTA4n_aCZa3aJYiSJ1rumh_x0&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fdp%2FB0DZDBWM5B%2Fref%3Dfs_a_mbt2_us2" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DZDBWM5B/ref=fs_a_mbt2_us2?th=1">15-inch MacBook Air</a> on Amazon, too.
